svg.text: Pickup weapon · area denial — Black Ledger armory dossier
“Deny the ground. Make them go the long way.”
Spray nozzle — lobbed in an arc
Ignites a fire zone that lingers 6s — area denial
An incendiary napalm canister, a dented orange
fuel cylinder with hazard stripes and a spray
Text-to-3D · Symmetry On · Quad · ~5k tris · PBR 2K
